name: Iced tea
description: Black tea brewed strong, sweetened and chilled, usually with lemon.

tcm.note: Black tea served cold with citrus.

ayurveda.note: Tea and lemon are both ushna.

histamine.note: Black tea plus lemon, and bottled versions sit for months.

stimulant.note: Black tea base, usually sweetened enough that the sugar shapes the curve as much as the caffeine.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what sugar and dilution leave in a chilled glass like this one. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
